messages:
cj: heads up — CI image publish is failing on main (buildkite #4812). started after landing the dockerfile ENV tweak. job failing at `docker buildx build --push` with a registry 403 and a 0-byte blob write in the logs.

infra-ci: [job link] https://ci.internal/builds/4812 — failing step: publish-image. last log lines attached.

cj: log excerpt:
```
> uploading layer sha256:abcd...
> PATCH https://registry.redwood.internal/v2/redwood/runtime/blobs/uploads/... 403
> server response: invalid auth token
> wrote 0 bytes for blob
```

alex: did we rotate the registry token earlier today? Tina pushed a creds rotation PR last night that touched the CI secret store.

tina: i merged a small ENV cleanup (strip trailing slash on REGISTRY_URL) but didn't touch tokens. i can trawl the commit if needed.

mike: 403 on PATCH usually means the session expired or the upload id was invalid. could be buildkit/parallel chunking exposed a bug in our registry proxy where upload ids get dropped. seen similar with concurrent kaniko runs.

ellie: could be cache-layer mismatch too — if the builder reuses a cached layer digest but the registry GC/replica had a different view you'll see 0-byte/manifest mismatch.

alex: quick triage: 1) rerun job with `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0` to force non-parallel upload, 2) or rerun with `--no-cache` to avoid reusing local layer cache, 3) check ci secret `REGISTRY_TOKEN` age.

cj: trying a rerun with `--no-cache` now. tagging it `ci:rerun-no-cache`.

infra-ci: rerun triggered by cj — https://ci.internal/builds/4812/rerun-1

cj: rerun failed with same 403 after ~30s. attaching full http trace.

alex: can you paste the trace? also try `curl -v` to upload small blob with the same token from a bastion to reproduce. e.g. `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REGISTRY_TOKEN" <upload-url>`

cj: curl against the upload endpoint from bastion returns 201 for a small test blob. so token looks fine from bastion.

mike: interesting — that points at builder-specific behavior. what's the builder image? buildx latest?

cj: we're using buildx 0.11.3 on the agents. i also tried `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0` and that still failed but with slightly different timing.

ellie: can we try forcing a single-threaded chunked upload (lower concurrency) or pin to buildkit commit we know worked a week ago? also check proxy logs for dropped connections.

tina: i'm seeing a bunch of 499/connection aborted entries on the registry proxy around the same time window. guessing a GC job or network hiccup. i've opened ops ticket to check.

alex: next step: cj — can you bisect the commits that landed between last-green and now? specifically the dockerfile ENV tweak + any changes to the CI builder image. if it reproduces locally, we can roll back.

cj: starting bisect between commits `abc1234`..`def5678`. will run local buildx replicate with the same args and post results.

infra-ci: note — to reproduce closer to CI, run `docker buildx build --builder default --push --progress=plain --no-cache .` on an agent with same buildx version.

alex: if bisect shows it's the ENV change, we can revert and re-run release. if it's the builder, pin to previous. also i can escalate registry proxy team if we confirm concurrent uploads trigger it.

cj: update — local bisect: commit `a1b2c3` (the ENV trailing slash strip) reproduces the failure when buildx runs on our agent image. rolling back that small change locally fixes the upload.

tina: huh. odd. that change only modified `REGISTRY_URL` formatting. maybe buildx/kaniko constructs upload URLs differently when trailing slash differs.

mike: yep — if code concatenates `REGISTRY_URL + "/v2/.../blobs/uploads"` and there are double-slashes vs single, some proxies normalize differently and drop upload session params. that can cause invalid upload ids -> 403.

ellie: mitigation: revert the ENV normalization in CI until we patch builders to normalize, and add a unit test for URL join in the registry proxy.

alex: sounds good. cj, can you open a revert PR for CI env change and trigger a green run? i'll review quickly.

cj: opened PR 7221 to revert the env strip. kicking a canary. :thumbsup:

infra-ci: canary run triggered — https://ci.internal/builds/4812/canary-7221

cj: canary passed, publish step succeeded. marking incident as resolved for now. will follow up with a tiny registry proxy fix and a test.

tina: i'll add the URL-join unit test and follow up on proxy normalization.

alex: nice triage team. great detective work. :clap:

mike: filing a follow-up ticket to add regression test and notes about buildx quirks.

cj: thanks all — closing this thread.
